summary: After {person} turns down rail funding, other states receive the money.
realLife: Federal rail funds Wisconsin governor Scott Walker opposed went to other states.
gates: A rail grant has been offered and may be reassigned if declined.
weights: An approaching acceptance deadline gives a revised offer less time to succeed.
inGame: needs: the disposition of a declined grant.

turns.what: The state accepts the grant before it expires.
turns.pulledBy: The executive signs after securing the required local match.
turns.writesBack: The award records the state as recipient.

turns.what: The state retains funding for one segment.
turns.pulledBy: The granting agency approves a smaller project.
turns.writesBack: The revised award identifies the funded segment.
